title: Pink Haired Hammer Girl
description: Four vertically stacked poses of the same female character with bright pink hair, wearing a pink and black armored outfit with green accents. She carries a large purple and black hammer with a spiked head and holds a matching purple spear in various action stances against a solid gray background. The third pose includes a yellow comic book style 'IMPACT' burst effect near her fist.
prompt: A female character with vibrant pink hair in a high ponytail, wearing a form-fitting pink and black tactical outfit with armored shoulder pads and green utility belt, holding a large purple spiked hammer on her back and a matching purple spear. Shown in four different dynamic action poses vertically arranged, including combat stances with fists raised and weapon ready, comic book style linework with bold black outlines and vibrant cel-shaded coloring on a plain gray background
